narumiruna-pi-plan-mode.notes: Agent-assisted findings pending Tyler's own sign-off (disposition/reviewer/approved_by/approved_date left for hand-edit). License: MIT confirmed via third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/LICENSE and third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/package.json's license field. Network: no fetch/http/axios/XMLHttpRequest call sites anywhere in third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/src. Subprocess: no child_process/execSync/spawn/execFile call sites in third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/src or third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/scripts; the sole 'exec(' hit is RegExp.prototype.exec in third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/src/plan-mode.ts, not a subprocess call. Secrets/env: zero process.env reads anywhere in third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/src. Filesystem writes: third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/src/plan-export.ts writes the exported plan via exclusive-create (flag: 'wx', never clobbers an existing file) after resolving the target path with NUL-byte rejection; third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/src/settings.ts writes settings via a temp-file-then-atomic-rename pattern with mode 0o600, a byte-size cap, and temp-file cleanup in a finally block. Both are scoped to paths the caller explicitly passes (ctx.cwd-relative or the settings path), no writes outside the extension's own declared surface. Lifecycle scripts: no preinstall/postinstall in third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/package.json; 'prepack' only runs the package's own esbuild-based build (build-runtime.mjs), which is self-contained (writes only under its own dist/, with symlink-escape protection via assertSafeOutputDirectory and atomic rename-with-backup via publishRuntime) -- no network/subprocess/env access in that script either. Fail-closed tool policy (the required-review item for this candidate, per full-featured-profile-research.md): third-party/narumiruna-pi-plan-mode/src/tool-policy.ts denies edit/write unconditionally in plan mode (BLOCKED_BUILTIN_TOOLS), treats non-builtin (MCP/custom) tools as 'user-opt-in' rather than auto-allowed, and for bash/powershell parses each ';'/'|'/'&&'-separated segment against an explicit allow-list (READ_ONLY_COMMANDS / READ_ONLY_POWERSHELL_COMMANDS / a configurable safe-subcommand set for git and gh) -- an unrecognized command, shell-expansion syntax ($()/backticks/redirects/subshells), or an unquoted '&'/background operator is rejected by default (fail closed), not allowed. Worktree cleanup / children-inherit-secrets: not applicable to this candidate -- it spawns no subprocesses and manages no child sessions (unlike gotgenes-pi-packages' subagents), so there is no child-inheritance surface to review. Upstream tests at 04aae270c51cf4de70479d84317eb15ac8e20e33: 265 tests across 26 files for @narumitw/pi-plan-mode; 262 passed cleanly in a full-suite run.
